description: This file defines a minimal implementation of an SQLiteOpenHelper subclass, LocalDbHelper, used for managing a local database in an Android application. It handles creating and upgrading a database named 'budgetbuddy.db' with an 'expenses' table, including indexes on 'timestamp' and 'category'.

classes.name: LocalDbHelper
classes.description: A helper class extending SQLiteOpenHelper to manage the local expenses database for the app, providing methods for creation and upgrade.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the expenses table and indexes when the database is first created.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Drops existing expenses table and recreates it during an upgrade, for initial versions.
